script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUNNY DAY - MORNING - LOS ANGELES, CA

We open on a breathtaking view of the city skyline. The sun rises, casting a warm glow over everything. A bird flies by, complete silence.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(softly)
In the heart of Los Angeles, where ambition and creativity collide, lies a prestigious marketing firm known as "The Agency."

INT. THE AGENCY - DAY

A beautifully designed office space, filled with smiling employees working diligently at their desks.

JESSICA (mid 30s, ambitious, determined) enters, carrying a cup of coffee. She greets her colleagues with a friendly smile and a "good morning." As she walks towards her cubicle, she spots MARK (mid 40s, successful, confident) entering his office.

JESSICA
(under her breath)
Always first.

MARK
(smiling)
Morning, Jessica.

MARK exits his office, leaving JESSICA feeling a pang of envy.

INT. THE AGENCY - BREAK ROOM - DAY

JESSICA sits at a table with RACHEL (mid 20s, eager, ambitious) and MIKE (early 30s, content, laid-back). They discuss their latest project.

RACHEL
I really think we can make a difference with this campaign.

JESSICA
(skeptical)
We've been working on it for weeks. How is it any different now?

MIKE
(laughs)
Relax, Jess. It's all about perspective.

Suddenly, JENNIFER (late 30s, cynical, jaded) enters.

JENNIFER
(sarcastically)
Perspective? Yeah, like how we'll all still be here, doing the same thing, in five years.

INT. THE AGENCY - MARK'S OFFICE - DAY

MARK sits at his desk, looking at a photo of himself and JESSICA from years ago. He reflects on their past relationship and how it ended due to his own ambition.

MARK
(talking to himself)
I can't let that happen again.

INT. THE AGENCY - MEETING ROOM - DAY

The team gathers for a meeting. They discuss strategies and ideas for their latest campaign. JESSICA presents her concept, which is met with enthusiasm from everyone except MARK.

MARK
(disapprovingly)
That won't work. We need something more... groundbreaking.

JESSICA is hurt and frustrated, but she keeps her cool.

JESSICA
Then I'll work on something else.

INT. THE AGENCY - JESSICA'S CUBICLE - NIGHT

JESSICA stays late to work on a new idea. She is determined to prove herself to MARK and the rest of the team.

INT. THE AGENCY - THE NEXT DAY - MORNING

JESSICA arrives early, eager to present her new idea. She finds MARK in the break room, looking at his emails on his phone.

JESSICA
(excitedly)
I've got it! A campaign that will truly make a difference.

MARK looks up, intrigued.

MARK
(surprised)
Really? I'd love to see it.

INT. THE AGENCY - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

The team gathers to discuss Jessica's new idea. They are all impressed and excited, including MARK.

MARK
(smiling)
Jessica, this is exactly what we needed.

JESSICA beams with pride.

INT. THE AGENCY - DAY - WEEKS LATER

The team works together to bring Jessica's campaign to life. They celebrate their success and the bond they have formed.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Ambition, when fueled by passion and collaboration, can lead to remarkable achievements.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
